updates.text: Jones-Drew pressed the Power landmark, read the puller and kept the ball through controlled strip attempts. Those are controlled-contact findings. The team protection periods did not supply a separate individual pass-protection finding.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Twenty-two carries for 93 yards at 4.2 in 76 snaps: the 10-yard Outside Zone run on third-and-10 before the half, 7 and 7 on Power from Ace on the 51-yard field-goal drive, and the 10 on the access run and 7 on Power Left that set the winning kick in overtime; the 5-yard loss on Inside Zone at the Philadelphia 30 and the 3-yard loss on the first access run are the two negative carries. Three catches for 1 on six targets, including the minus 4 on the Y-Cross throw in overtime. A minor lower-extremity injury was logged at the end of the fourth-quarter field-goal drive at 4:15; he was not removed and played the overtime: out, projected return in five days (September 12), reassessment September 8 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/maurice_jones_drew_2014-09-07.md)). Anderson and Grimes remain the carried order behind him.
updates.source: Source: [Week 1 game record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_01/output.md) and its public receipt. This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Reassessed Monday with no change and cleared Friday, September 12, his projected date, without being inserted into the Friday practice; he did not practice Wednesday through Friday and took the Saturday walkthrough in full. Anderson and Grimes took the week's backfield work in the chart's order. Stone dressed him for Washington with no touch quota and the carried order behind him rehearsed; no finding attaches to the week.
updates.source: Source: [Week 2 record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_02/output.md) and the [medical history](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/medical_history.md#september-8-to-12-jones-drew-reassessed-and-cleared-harris-and-lowery-to-reserveinjured). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Maurice Jones-Drew has proven himself an NFL starting running back, carrying {{2013.regular.rushing_attempts}} times for {{2013.regular.rushing_yards}} yards as Jacksonville's lead back in 2013 and {{2014.regular.rushing_attempts}} times for {{2014.regular.rushing_yards}} yards so far in 2014. He is a compact, powerful and complete veteran runner who wins with his decisions on the run track, his balance through contact and his short-yardage finishing, and he adds useful protection work. His inside efficiency matters more than his open-field speed, and long speed and route detail are the least of his tools.

transactions.text: Signed a contract extension with Jacksonville
Re-signed with Jacksonville for two years (2014 to 2015)
